title: Australian Pineapple Naan Bites
description: A sweet and savory twist on traditional naan, infused with the flavors of Australia and featuring caramelized pineapple.
instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, yeast, and salt. Mix well.
2. Gradually add the pineapple juice to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
3. Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
4. Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
5. Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
6. Divide the dough into 8-10 equal portions and shape each portion into a ball.
7. Roll out each ball into a thin circle.
8. Brush the naan with melted butter and sprinkle with cinnamon and cardamom.
9. Cook the naan for 1-2 minutes on each side, until it is golden brown and puffed up.
10. Serve the naan warm with caramelized pineapple chunks.
11. To caramelize the pineapple, heat a tablespoon of butter in a pan over medium heat until melted. Add the pineapple chunks and cook for 5-7 minutes, until they are golden brown and caramelized.
